verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents its own spend controls that cover the pieces of this story. Velocity controls cap both how much can be spent and how many transactions are allowed in a time span, which approximates one purchase. Authorization controls restrict spending to a single merchant. Gateway JIT funding lets your system approve or deny each authorization with its own rules, which could enforce an exact amount. However, the evidence never describes a native single-use card type, and the controls are described as applying to users rather than to individual cards. Missing for 10: an explicit single-use or burner card feature, documented per-card scoping of velocity and merchant controls, exact-amount locking or auto-termination after first use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
